title: hytale visuals and textures
description: A Hytale-inspired resource pack that adds vibrant textures and shader-like visuals without requiring shaders or impacting performance. Enjoy a more colorful world while maintaining smooth gameplay.
body:
**THIS MOD REQUIRES SODUIM CORE SHADER SUPPORT**

Transform your Minecraft world with a Hytale-inspired visual overhaul designed to look great without the performance cost of traditional shaders. This resource pack features vibrant textures, enhanced colors, improved lighting effects, and subtle visual details that give the game a more lively and polished appearance. Every biome feels richer and more immersive while staying true to Minecraft's original style. Best of all, all effects are achieved through the resource pack itself, meaning you can enjoy a shader-like experience without installing shaders or sacrificing smooth performance. Perfect for players who want a fresh, modern look on any system.
